documentation_excerpts.text: Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats — including advanced PDF understanding — and providing seamless integrations with the generative AI ecosystem.

- 🗂️ Parsing of [multiple document formats][supported_formats] including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, Apple Pages, WAV, MP3, WebVTT, Box Notes, email formats (EML, MSG), images (PNG, TIFF, JPEG, ...), LaTeX, DocLang, plain text, and more - 📑 Advanced PDF understanding incl. page layout, reading order, table structure, code, formulas, image classification, and more - 🧬 A unified, expressive [DoclingDocument][docling_document] representation format - ↪️ Various [export formats][supported_for
